_comment: Research tree. Cost = research points (from engineers + office) and money. Effects: mult (multiplies a modifier stat), add (adds to an additive stat), unlock (facility:<id> | tool:<tier> | role:<id> | feature:<id>), mitigate (hazard), flag (named rule switch). 'column' and 'tier' place the node in the UI tree.
